Field
Description
TargetProcessId
The unique ID of a target process (in decimal, non-hex format). This field exists in almost all events, and it represents the
ID of the process that is responsible for the activity of the event in focus. For example, the TargetProcessId of a process
that performed thread injection in an InjectedThread event
ImageFileName
The full path to an executable (PE) file. The context of this field provides more information as to its meaning. For
ProcessRollup2 events, this is the full path to the main executable for the created process.
SHA256HashData
The SHA256 hash of a file. In most cases, the hash of the file referred to by the ImageFileName field.

ModuleLoadTelemetryClassification
A bitfield indicating which module load telemetry classifications apply to the module load.
The values have the following meanings:
FIRST_LOAD (0x00000001): This is the first time this module has been loaded into a process on the host.
RUNDLL32_TARGET (0x00000002): This module is the target of a rundll32.exe invocation.
DETECT_TREE (0x00000004): The module was loaded into a process that is in an active detect tree.
MAPPED_FROM_KERNEL_MODE (0x00000008): The module was loaded into kernel mode address space.
UNUSUAL_EXTENSION (0x00000010): The module has an unexpected, unusual or rare extension.
MOTW (0x00000020): The module has the Mark of the Web zone identifier.
SIGN_INFO_CONTINUITY (0x00000040): The module does not have a valid signature and it was loaded into a
process with a primary module that does have a valid signature.
CLOUD_ALL (0x00000080): This has been deprecated.
ORIGINAL_FILENAME_MISMATCH (0x00000100): Module's ImageFileName doesn't match OriginalFileName.
REMOVABLE_MEDIA (0x00000200): The module was loaded from removable media (ISO/IMG).
DATA_EXTENSION (0x00000400): The module has a data type extension.
